_meta: TEMPLATE — copy to orphan-scan.config.json and tune per project. All keys are OPTIONAL; defaults match orphan-scan.mjs and suit the JS/TS reference stack. STACK-AGNOSTIC: classification prefers the registry Type column and falls back to prefix, so a project using PG instead of PAGE works without code changes — set realizing_types/test_types to your registry's Type vocabulary, or add e.g. "PYTEST" to test_prefixes.
_control_dir: Dir holding ID_REGISTRY.md + TRACEABILITY_MATRIX.md, resolved RELATIVE TO THE ORCHESTRATOR DIR (same place reconcile.mjs reads control artifacts). "." = the orchestrator dir itself; use "../control" if they live in a sibling control/ folder (as the self-test does). The --control-dir CLI flag, for ad-hoc runs, resolves relative to your CWD instead.
_rule_prefixes: Requirement-like rules (business rules). Rows naming these are checked for realizing+test like requirements, so an unrealized/untested rule with Status OK cannot pass invisibly.
_realizing_types: PREFERRED classifier: registry Type-column values that count as a realizing op (robust to prefix vocab like PG vs PAGE).
_test_types: PREFERRED classifier: registry Type-column values that count as a test.
_justification_prefixes: A DEFERRED/RISK row with a broken chain must link one of these (in the row, or via the requirement's Source IDs) — otherwise the deferral is a SILENT DROP and fails the gate.
